cartridges.title: Strike Pixel
cartridges.subtitle: Sunrelay Yard
cartridges.description: An original offline arena FPS. Three weapons, a sunlit block-built yard and a crew of local bots. No accounts or purchases.

cartridges.title: Circuit Vice
cartridges.subtitle: District 09 // Night Response
cartridges.description: Original 2.5D offline arcade action: rescue, arrest, and stop the reactor sentinel. NC-002 preview adds animated poses, fair attack warnings, procedural soundtrack and a polished HUD.

cartridges.title: Blade Circuit
cartridges.subtitle: Glassline Foundry
cartridges.description: Cross a glass foundry guarded by three clockwork wardens. Chain blade cuts, catch a strike on your guard and open the exit lift.

cartridges.title: Neon Apex
cartridges.subtitle: Original racing concept
cartridges.description: A cabinet concept for the catalogue's arcade racing ideas: scenic roads, readable handling and original tracks. No game has been built yet.

cartridges.title: Starward Signal
cartridges.subtitle: Original spaceflight concept
cartridges.description: A cabinet concept for the catalogue's space combat ideas: original ships, flight and distant encounters. No game has been built yet.

cartridges.title: Orbital Pinball
cartridges.subtitle: Asterion Relay
cartridges.description: Send three balls through the Asterion Relay. Charge a skill shot, complete beacon banks and nudge a trapped ball back into play.
